corrected_Leech_input.warning: No frame-independent identification of V2 with one of the nine length-24 Type II code classes is used.

conditional_theorem: If the 4,095 intrinsic V2 frames, 416 Hall-Janko copies and 20,800 G2(4) edges all surject onto one common selector set with constant fiber size on each source, its size divides gcd(4095,416,20800)=13. The only nontrivial possible uniform common quotient therefore has exactly 13 states.
boundary: Conditional divisibility theorem only; uniformity/equivariance and existence of a 13-state quotient remain open.
